Clinical Indication | Date: 15 February 2025 | Institution: Ziekenhuis Gelderse Vallei (Ede) | Study: Multiparametric MRI Prostate

Evaluation initiated for a PSA value of 10.0 alongside a history of a prior Negative biopsy. The gland demonstrates a total volume of 90.0 mL. T2-weighted sequences highlight a 12 × 8 mm focus of intermediate signal within the right peripheral zone at the mid-gland. Diffusion-weighted imaging confirms restricted diffusion with intermediate apparent diffusion coefficient values. Dynamic contrast phases reveal moderate, non-specific wash-in and wash-out kinetics. There is no evidence of extraprostatic extension, seminal vesicle invasion, or pelvic lymphadenopathy.

IMPRESSION:
1. Prostate volume 90.0 mL.
2. PI-RADS 3 lesion in the right mid-peripheral zone.
3. PSAD 0.17 ng/mL/mL.
4. csPCa predicted probability 0.0
